relations.text: 消費者向け事業の顧客で、2025年の連結売上高の約12%を占めた
relations.text_en: A Consumer segment customer accounting for approximately 12% of consolidated sales in 2025

source.label: McCormick 10-K(2025年11月30日期)
source.quote: Sales to one of our Consumer segment customers, Wal-Mart Stores, Inc., accounted for consolidated sales of approximately 12% in 2025, 2024, and 2023.

relations.text: フレーバー・ソリューションズ事業の顧客で、2025年の連結売上高の約12%を占めた
relations.text_en: A Flavor Solutions segment customer accounting for approximately 12% of consolidated sales in 2025

source.label: McCormick 10-K(2025年11月30日期)
source.quote: Sales to one of our Flavor Solutions segment customers, PepsiCo, Inc., accounted for consolidated sales of approximately 12% in 2025, and 13% in both 2024 and 2023.

relations.text: 合弁のマコーミック・デ・メヒコの持分25%を7億5,000万ドルで追加取得し、出資比率は75%になった
relations.text_en: McCormick acquired an additional 25% interest in McCormick de Mexico from Grupo Herdez for $750 million, raising its stake to 75%

source.label: McCormick 10-K(2025年11月30日期)
source.quote: On January 2, 2026, we acquired an additional 25% ownership interest in McCormick de Mexico from Grupo Herdez, for $750 million which increased our ownership interest to a 75% controlling interest.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
